ticker_news.title: US Stocks Set For A Cautious Start Ahead Of Inflation Data: Expert Says 'Strong Bull Markets Tend To Roar Back To Life After Corrections'
ticker_news.description: U.S. stock futures fell ahead of the release of inflation data, with traders expecting a modest report that could signal easing price pressures and potential interest rate cuts by the Federal Reserve. Experts noted a 'weak recovery' in the market, but sentiment remains constructive.
ticker_news.author: Rishabh Mishra

SPY.title: Inflation Rises More Than Expected In January, Chills Interest Rate Cut Hopes
SPY.description: Inflation surged more than expected in January, with CPI rising 3% year-over-year and 0.5% month-over-month, exceeding forecasts and dampening investor hopes for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari
